definitions.explanation: Work involving building, repairing, or maintaining structures, roads, or facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧{工事|こうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}している→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧。
examples.english: There's a traffic jam due to road construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧{工事|こうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{断水|だんすい}→断水：04518_dansui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to water pipe construction, there will be no water service tomorrow.

notes:
{工事|こうじ} refers to construction or engineering work. It's commonly seen on signs indicating construction zones.

Common collocations:
- {工事中|こうじちゅう} (under construction)
- {工事|こうじ}を{行|おこな}う (to carry out construction)
- {工事現場|こうじげんば} (construction site)
- {道路|どうろ}{工事|こうじ} (road construction)
- {水道|すいどう}{工事|こうじ} (plumbing work)
- {電気|でんき}{工事|こうじ} (electrical work)

Related words:
- {建設|けんせつ} - construction (building something new)
- {工事|こうじ} - construction work (broader, includes repairs)
